title: Ordering breakfast on the sly in a Louisiana town
summary: A story of three band members getting free food and wine and being blamed for ordering breakfast.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So, man comes to get up. Don't want to try to change your voice. I said, get up. We said, well, don't try to change your voice. Get up out of that bed. We said, buddy, she was going to put us all up in the rain. Where was this? In the, in the, in the blues, on the Fangle, Louisiana. Oh, yeah, we played Fangle. It's a storming, man. We went up and we made poor Ernest Kelly, so now we're scared of Ernest Kelly, they beat us up, you know. So we went over and they said, one, the bar on one side and the girls on the other. One will go there and get some cheese, the other will steal on this side and steal the wine, you know. The bottle had the cup and everything. We go there and get a nickel of cheese. When they come back, the guy get a cup of wine, and then the other will go get a nickel of cakes, come back, and the other guy says, three of us, you know, we all got juice, man. We juice and mayonnaise. So now we all juiced. We juiced. The mayonnaise. The man woke up when we was doing, he put us out. So it was daylight then. So it was time for us to go to get the change, we get in the other town, we ordered breakfast, me, butter, and tea, and sitting there. My aunt's Kelly in this same room. We all three was in the room together, give us one bed together, a couple of dozen eggs, putting my head on the car, and say, I'm a big. So when I was tired of paying off for this food, the man wouldn't know who ordered us to say that big one. It was only you. I don't know nothing. Listen at him.
Listen at him. Talk like you was talking last night.
Don't come up here and talk that baby voice to me. I heard you. I know it was none of them boys ordered. And we just hide behind some tree peeping that man he brought us all around the block.
Sit over here. Sit over here. Sit over here.
